description: Cargo via Doha International Airport by month and year is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset contains cargo shipment data for Doha International Airport, categorized by type (Dispatched or Received), month, and year. It includes data for each month of 2014, showing the total weight of cargo in tons for each type of shipment (Dispatched and Received). Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are aircraft, cargo. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-08-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, transport network and mobility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
